climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Balaton PDO on the northern shore of Lake Balaton, around Mount Badacsony in central Transdanubia. Welschriesling is the most planted grape at 43% of vineyard area, ahead of Pinot Gris at 14%, and the allowed grapes include Kéknyelű and Furmint.
